_help.about: [NOT WIRED YET — design §FY] (22 Oct) What a weapon can touch. Every creature that lurks carries one substance tag; the weapon never cares about the dark, only what the thing is made of. Mike: 'what lurks in the dark could be flesh and blood'; 'mummy is flesh- maybe not blood tho'; 'spear should have more reach than torch'. Tags and numbers are Claude's first guesses for Mike's eye.
_help.classes: flesh_blood: spear and bow wound and kill, light pushes back. flesh_no_blood: a hit lands and staggers but never stops it; only fire finishes it. no_flesh: weapons pass through; light alone (the torch's stagger is the light, so it still works).
_help.reach: metres, first guesses (§FY.3). The torch lights as it swings; the spear does not; the bow takes both hands so the torch goes to the belt.

notes.swamp: the witch: no_flesh in her own shape; under the brew she reads flesh_blood (§FT keeps it ambiguous)
notes.volcano: the dragon: flesh_blood, and still the one maker of fire (§EY)
